learner_operation: Inspect the given equation and each option; identify an algebraically equivalent equation with unit derivative coefficient, all y terms on the left, and y-independent right side. Standard-form recognition alone is insufficient when several options share that form.

fixed_features.justification: Tutorial d0517ea0-b60e-5c34-bfbc-41fd6c61af75 defines the assessed form; its target is essential.

fixed_features.feature: First derivative, x-only P/Q, no integration, one of five radio choices
fixed_features.justification: All nine captured questions ask the same conversion and use five-option radio banks. Changes to operator order or response type would assess other skills.

fixed_features.feature: Supported function shapes and short algebraic stage sequences
fixed_features.justification: Preserve the source rearrangement, cancellation and normalization workloads; hard square expansion remains isolated. These constraints do not require source-example signs, magnitudes or key positions.
Preserve original equation domains; in particular y != 0 is essential when canceling y.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary eligible coefficient magnitudes and signs while deriving the prompt and all solution steps consistently.
answer_roles.observed: All eight easy families vary this role. P-only sign counterfactuals and five-way fixed-bank reassignment passed exact math and native grading.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary independently of P in easy families without requiring new algebra.
answer_roles.observed: Independent forcing signs and coefficients tested. In hard square expansion Q=a^2 is necessarily positive for this family; varying a changes Q.

answer_roles.role: Correct mathematical candidate and display position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any of five candidates may satisfy the conversion; display order may vary without changing the mathematical answer.
answer_roles.observed: All five mathematical key assignments exercised in each of ten templates; no constant first/last or value cue. Ten shuffle controls preserve the answer.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary supported nonzero constants, reciprocal powers, exponential rates and trigonometric frequencies while retaining the same conversion.
answer_roles.observed: Original and boundary values tested, including a=5 and n=8 easy cases; moderate a=8 and hard a=6,n=6. No sampled family lost to generator rejection.

coverage.case: Five-way reassignment within every easy, moderate and hard template
coverage.result: 10 banks held fixed; each of 5 candidates made correct by changing prompt evidence; 50 independently correct cases. Relevant controls also independently perturb P or Q sign in each easy family.

counterfactuals.change: Keep bank, template, seed and incidental coefficients fixed; reassign each of five candidate coefficient pairs to the prompt. Also flip only P or only Q sign in easy controls.
counterfactuals.expected: Recompute the standard-form equation; prompt and explanation must reflect new evidence and native grading must accept the new equation and reject the old one.
counterfactuals.observed: 56 relevant comparisons change prompt, solution and mathematical answer. Independent math validates all rows/keys; native grader exercises all five options for all 131 records. Renderer includes before/after fixed-bank cases in all templates plus P-only/Q-only sign pairs.
counterfactuals.justification: Lesson explicitly defines P=b/a and Q=f/a: changing either answer-bearing role must change the equivalent standard form.

counterfactuals.change: Change only the shuffle seed with explicit coefficients and complete candidate catalog held fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt, standard-form equation and worked solution preserved; choice display order may change.
counterfactuals.observed: 10/10 comparisons preserve prompt, mathematical answer and solution. Native grader checks all choices. q-16400 rendered prompt and full solution text match exactly across the shuffle control.
counterfactuals.justification: Option position is incidental to algebraic equivalence and the source standard-form criterion.

stages_examined: Generator family selection and validation/rejection loop
Publisher prepare_records normalization and inventory/within-batch deduplication
Difficulty-first inventory selection, seen-history exclusions and within-band hash draw
delivery.result: 104 independent easy records become 96 after 8 deliberate shuffle duplicates; all eight families and all four sign pairs survive. Runner batch remains 5/5. Prior side-frequency cue succeeds 0/96 and 0/5 after filtering; all eligible members checked, so learner history cannot revive that unique-maximum cue. Selection rules examined analytically plus 128 conditional SHA256 draws.

limitations: Finite audit tests specific cues; it does not prove absence of every shortcut.
Inventory is captured at basis 5230. No preparation file exists; check_delivery reproduces actual publisher preparation read-only. Later inventory changes are outside this evidence.

No live policy weights, future assigned entity IDs or learner histories are supplied. Selection draws use stated fresh easy-band conditions and synthetic UUID order; uniform-within-band and subset properties are independent of that order.

Four captured generated records are historical hard items; all content matches the retained prior records and none demonstrates the earlier unique-maximum frequency cue. This is a rule-specific verified absence; original source records are not classified as generated.
